name: @contempo/web
description: Contempo web app + Cloudflare Worker: dashboard, entries, billing, legal pages, the admin site (/admin/), the feedback form (/feedback/) and the API that replaced the Firebase Cloud Functions

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run assemble
scripts.assemble: vite build && npm run build -w @contempo/admin && rm -rf dist/admin dist/feedback && cp -R ../admin/dist dist/admin && cp -R ../../feedback/public dist/feedback
scripts.deploy: npm run assemble && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.upload-version: npm run assemble && wrangler versions upload --env production
